mapper.select: SELECT id FROM interviewworks_ticket.session WHERE id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.id, s.activity_id, s.date, s.time, a.name, a.price FROM interviewworks_ticket.session s JOIN interviewworks_ticket.activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE s.id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interviewworks_ticket.session_seat(session_id, seat_id) SELECT DISTINCT s.id, #{seat} FROM interviewworks_ticket.session s JOIN interviewworks_ticket.seat layout ON layout.activity_id = s.activity_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(layout.seat_rows, ',')) r(label) CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, least(layout.seats_per_row, 99)::int) n(num) WHERE s.id = #{sessionId} AND trim (r.label) || '-' || lpad(n.num::text , 2 , '0') = #{seat} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE interviewworks_ticket.session_seat SET status = 'RESERVED', reserved_by_order = #{orderno}, reserved_until = #{expires_at}, version = version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{session_id} AND seat_id = #{seat} AND status = 'AVAILABLE'
mapper.select: SELECT orderno FROM interviewworks_ticket.ticket WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY expires_at, orderno LIMIT 100
SELECT seat_id FROM interviewworks_ticket.session_seat WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status <> 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY seat_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interviewworks_ticket.booking_idempotency(email, idempotency_key, request_hash) VALUES (#{email}, #{key}, #{hash}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
